description: The unsigned transaction that puts money into the account once it is open: a plain transfer of the token (ETH as value) from the owner's wallet, booked by the account as money put in. Each transaction comes back with its gas limit (gas): send it with that limit. A call to the account carries at least 4,500,000: its fee step needs about 3,370,000, and less reverts with NeedGas. Needs the owner's signed request (auth) for request "deposit".

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

amount.description: A decimal amount in the token's own units, like "25" or "0.5".

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

token.description: USDG, ETH, WETH, or a stock token symbol (SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, SPCX, PLTR, COIN, MSTR, GME).
